en.headline: Hong Kong Sinfonietta plays Bach’s Legacy at City Hall tonight
en.dek: Recorder player Stefan Temmingh and harpsichordist Sebastian Wienand join the orchestra’s string musicians at 8 p.m. for a programme of Bach family works and an Asian première.
body: Hong Kong Sinfonietta presents Bach’s Legacy at 8 p.m. on Thursday at the Hong Kong City Hall Concert Hall, the first of two late-August programmes built around Baroque music. Recorder player Stefan Temmingh and harpsichordist Sebastian Wienand appear with the orchestra’s string musicians. Tickets are priced at HK$480, HK$320 and HK$200 through URBTIX and POPTICKET.

The programme includes J. C. F. Bach’s Symphony in D minor, J. S. Bach’s Organ Concerto BWV 593 after Vivaldi transcribed for recorder and harpsichord, J. C. Bach’s Harpsichord Concerto No. 6 in F minor, and the J. S. Bach / C. P. E. Bach Sonata in E-flat. Temmingh will also play Marcello’s Oboe Concerto in D minor on recorder, with ornaments by J. S. Bach.

The concert includes the Asian première of two movements from Elena Kats-Chernin’s Re-Inventions for Recorder and Strings (2004), based on J. S. Bach inventions and written for tenor and sopranino recorders. Temmingh returns on Saturday, 29 August, at the same hall for Vivaldi’s Recorder Concerto RV 443, the Hong Kong première of Thomas Koppel’s Moonchild’s Dream, and Rimsky-Korsakov’s Scheherazade, conducted by Music Director Emeritus Yip Wing-sie.

zh.headline: 香港小交響樂團今晚城廳上演「巴赫的傳承」
zh.dek: 直笛演奏家Stefan Temmingh與鍵琴家Sebastian Wienand今晚8時在香港大會堂音樂廳，與樂團弦樂組演出巴赫家族作品及一闕亞洲首演。
body: 香港小交響樂團周四晚上8時於香港大會堂音樂廳舉行「巴赫的傳承」，是八月下旬兩場巴羅克主題音樂會的第一場。直笛演奏家Stefan Temmingh與鍵琴家Sebastian Wienand將與樂團弦樂組同台。門票分480元、320元及200元，可經城市售票網及POPTICKET購買。
節目包括J. C. F. 巴赫D小調交響曲、J. S. 巴赫改編自維瓦爾第的管風琴協奏曲BWV 593（直笛與鍵琴版）、J. C. 巴赫F小調第六鍵琴協奏曲，以及J. S. 巴赫／C. P. E. 巴赫降E大調奏鳴曲。Temmingh亦會以直笛演奏馬切洛D小調雙簧管協奏曲，並加入J. S. 巴赫的裝飾音。
音樂會亦包括Elena Kats-Chernin 2004年作品《再創》直笛與弦樂選段的亞洲首演，兩段分別以次中音及高音直笛演奏，取材自J. S. 巴赫創意曲。Temmingh周六（8月29日）將再於同一場地演出維瓦爾第直笛協奏曲RV 443、Thomas Koppel《月孩之夢》香港首演，以及林姆斯基－高沙可夫《天方夜譚」，由榮譽音樂總監葉詠詩指揮。
